newsitem.title: CHINA: Earthquake of 6.4 rocks western China.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake of 6.4 rocks western China.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 6.4 on the open-ended Richter scale rocked China's westernmost Xinjiang region on Tuesday, state television said.
No reports of casualties had yet been received, it said.
The earthquake struck the Jiashi district of Xinjiang near the mountainous region of Tibet at 9.47 a.m. (0147 GMT), state television said.
Local officials had reported that some houses had collapsed and cracks had appeared in others, it said.
A special task force had been organised to check on damage throughout the district and to help with any relief work, it said. It gave no more details.
